threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: Father William, the priest, marked the Barrow Mound and the witch's home on it. You still don't know where all its marked places are, or which one holds the treasure.

threads.label: The black dragon
threads.text: George says its lair is below the northern mountains, and nothing pierces its scales. It can't fly yet, but he says it soon will. Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold.

threads.label: Naggeneen the Clurichen
threads.text: He was stealing Quinn's ale until Trout bagged him, and Quinn hung him behind the bar.

threads.label: Bentley's missing shipment
threads.text: Nothing has reached Brandonsford, and you still don't know what happened to it.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.text: For a hundred gold a week, he and his killer wasp will do anything, as long as he gets to kill people.

threads.label: Squints
threads.text: Trout recruited the halfling as a junior member of his Halfling Corps. You owe Squints second pick of the first treasure, after the elite members.

threads.label: Warwick's mithril shirt
threads.text: It could protect against the dragon. Dunk plans to be inside with it tonight while Warwick sleeps, though the diluted wine and Ingrid's uncertain skill may weaken the potion.

threads.label: Dunk's deal with Ingrid
threads.text: She secretly watches Warwick sleep, and will brew him a sleeping potion from the faun wine Dunk gave her. Dunk must then help her into Warwick's house to give it.

threads.label: Brandon's sword
threads.text: Father William says only the sword buried with Sir Brandon can kill the dragon. George says no one knows whether that's true or where the sword lies.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah's promise
threads.text: In return for marking the map, he owes Father William penance at Brandon's Barrow Mound and a ten gold donation for its upkeep.

threads.label: The giant's stone cottage
threads.text: Squints pulled Brother Dirk out of it, and you outran the giant as it woke.

threads.label: Brother Dirk
threads.text: When he asked to go home, Sir Phidipaldi objected, and Trout assigned him to Squints.

threads.label: The faun grove
threads.text: Dunk out-drank the fauns there and traded a rabbit's foot for a flask of their wine.

threads.label: Ingrid's news about fairies
threads.text: She told Dr. Uriah that fairies who once stayed hidden are coming out more often.

closing: You're together in the woods across the field from the giant's stone cottage, north of town, with Squints and Brother Dirk. You're heading for the Barrow and pressing Dirk to come along, but he says he should just go home and hasn't agreed.
